preconditions.description: The number of strings k must be between 1 and 2500.
The length of each string n must be between 2 and 5000.
The total length of all strings combined must not exceed 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s_i) == n for s_i in strings)
preconditions.description: Each of the k strings must have a length of exactly n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or any(s_i == s for s_i in strings)
postconditions.description: The output must be either -1 if no suitable string exists, or a string s that can produce all given strings by swapping two characters.
If a suitable string s is output, its length must be equal to n.
